subject.title: fix(browser): time out relay WebSocket opening

question: Should the bundled browser extension adopt a nominal 30-second opening deadline that retries valid but exceptionally slow relay handshakes instead of waiting indefinitely?
rationale: The patch’s core behavior is intentionally a user-visible availability policy, not a mechanically provable correctness-only change; the supplied blackhole run proves recovery but cannot establish the preferred timeout policy for all deployments.

options.title: Accept the 30-second recovery policy
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete, treating bounded reconnects as preferable to an indefinite Connecting state.

options.title: Request a different timeout policy
options.body: Keep the PR open for an owner-selected deadline or an explicitly different recovery rule if slow legitimate handshakes need a longer allowance.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second recovery policy
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete, treating bounded reconnects as preferable to an indefinite Connecting state.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the recent branch history shows direct involvement in the relay-worker test surface.
